desc:
⚠️ The game is still in testing, expect bugs! ⚠️

Welcome to Wheelie Life 🏍️, the best e-bike and dirt bike stunt game on ROBLOX!

🏍️ 25+ bikes: Sur-Ron, Talaria, Stark Varg, KTM, Yamaha, GasGas and more
🤸 Real tricks: wheelies, one hand, no hands, seat stand, knee and stoppies
👮 Intense police chases with wanted stars, can you escape the cops?
🔧 Deep tuning: paint, plastics, supermoto wheels, batteries, motors and controllers
🎁 Crates with power upgrades to make your bike faster
👥 Ride with your friends, even two on one bike!
🏙️ A big city to explore, plus a skatepark

New bikes, tricks and updates are added all the time, so make sure to favourite ⭐ and like 👍 the game!

⚠️ This is a fan-made game. We are not associated with any of the bike brands shown. ⚠️
